# Zoé — components & tools (generated)

## <z-element> (core)
The living base: carries interaction states as :state() and emits z-state.
Attributes: current (boolean), loading (boolean), busy (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-layer> (core)
A layer: one piece of a component, carrying one role (part). Painted by the skin, placed by the component.
Attributes: part (string)

## <z-contact> (tools)
The click leaves a mark where the pointer touched. Write it once, flat: the whole page answers.
Attributes: fx (string), disabled (boolean)
Events: zoe:contact

## <z-checkbox> (components)
A checkbox — inherits all z-element states, marker + label anatomy, painted by the skin.
Attributes: current (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-button> (components)
A button — inherits all z-element states, skinnable by themes.
Attributes: disabled (boolean), loading (boolean), busy (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-radio> (components)
A radio button — z-element states, marker + label anatomy, selects but never unselects itself.
Attributes: value (string), current (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success

## <z-radio-group> (components)
A group of z-radio: single choice, arrow-key navigation, roving tabindex, one value.
Attributes: value (string), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, busy, disabled, error, success
